evidence.contradiction_scope: Challenges to candidate or stronger universal rules, not necessarily to the final qualified wording.
data_quality_notes: Source extractions reviewed; original videos were not reopened during synthesis.
Both dedicated player-role fields are empty in all input records; roles remain unknown except where explicit narrative evidence is cited.
Sample win rate is a property of selected footage, not expected ladder performance.
Absent events are unknown unless the record explicitly establishes availability or absence.
A reported enemy kill can occur after a friendly death; the round result is stored separately.
12 records carry source quality flags; consult evidence and exceptions before treating a claim as footage-verified.

facts.resource_count_limit: Exact source-listed labels, deduplicated within each match. They include uncertain or offensive entries and are not verified forced-resource frequencies.
facts.cc_count_limit: Literal mentions in observed notes, including negated/uncertain/post-death mentions. These are search aids, not counts of landed CC.
facts.recovery_count_limit: Field coverage only: texts may explicitly say no reset. Not a reset-event rate.

hypotheses.statement: One opening target also explains every reported enemy kill in wins.
hypotheses.limitation: Descriptive endpoint comparison. Does not establish intended kill target, causes, or conditional win probability.

hypotheses.statement: A meaningful Feral health deficit persists through renewed pressure, or Feral control opens a damaging Priest commitment.
hypotheses.limitation: Both-Trinkets-spent and continuous Priest denial are not necessary. Some Priest wins happen with Feral free or escapes still ready. Cyclone is not automatically fatal: both a loss and wins occur around it.

hypotheses.statement: A stronger fixed resource/target/control prerequisite is necessary.
hypotheses.limitation: Both-Trinkets-spent and continuous Priest denial are not necessary. Some Priest wins happen with Feral free or escapes still ready. Cyclone is not automatically fatal: both a loss and wins occur around it.

opening_target.text: Feral Druid; recorded in 25/31 games. This is the labeled opening target, not necessarily the first sustained coordinated damage.

initial_objective.text: Start from Feral pressure with Priest disruption; retain a Feral finish and a healer-switch option.

win_condition.text: A meaningful Feral health deficit persists through renewed pressure, or Feral control opens a damaging Priest commitment.

manufacture.text: Apply pressure to Feral and renew short Priest control/interrupts around actual health loss. If Feral pressure heals out, a real Priest switch is supported by several games.

conversion.text: Usually finish Feral; convert onto Priest when Feral control and actual Priest damage align.

reset.text: Repeat Feral pressure after partial or full heals; a healed Feral can also precede renewed Feral control and a Priest swap.

assessment.text: Conditional control resistance; low-health conversion sometimes follows its use, but many wins retain one or both escapes.

relevance_test.sufficiency_in_losses: Not established; compare the matchup failure examples.
relevance_test.pressure_side_effect: Cannot be excluded from a spend alone.
relevance_test.control_interaction: Conditional control resistance; low-health conversion sometimes follows its use, but many wins retain one or both escapes.
